How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question! Here's what to expect:
Tracking numbers are sent via email once your order ships. The timing depends on the shipping method:
Ground shipments (UPS or USPS): Tracking typically appears within a few business days after your order leaves production. Carriers may take several days to perform the first scan, so tracking might not show movement immediately even though your order is en route. Once scanned, ground deliveries usually take 2–5 business days to arrive.
In-home delivery items (furniture, larger mattresses shipped via BTX or SEKO): Tracking updates typically populate within 24–48 business hours after shipment. These items can take 1–3 weeks to arrive at a local delivery hub, and then the carrier will contact you to schedule your delivery appointment.
If tracking shows no movement for 7–10 business days, or if you haven't received a shipping confirmation email, feel free to reach out and the team can help monitor your shipment.

Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Unfortunately, expedited delivery options aren't available at this time.
Once an order is placed, the shipping method can't be upgraded or changed. Since most products are handcrafted in small batches, production time is built into the overall timeline — mattresses typically take 2–3 weeks to produce before they ship, and then delivery time is added on top of that.
That said, you do have a couple of options at checkout:
In-Home Delivery with setup — this is an upgraded service that includes a scheduled appointment and assembly, though it doesn't speed up production or transit time
Signature Required — ensures someone is home to receive the delivery with a scheduled appointment (vs. contactless doorstep delivery)
If timing is critical, I'd recommend reaching out to the sales team before placing your order — they can give you the most current production and delivery estimates for the specific product you're considering. Would you like me to connect you with them?
